blind.label: first WRONG “No workable plan” (a fix existed)

failure.label: first drone failure on a task

verified.note: Camera-2 failed; the Supply Drop needs 2 Lifters + 1 Camera or 1 Lifter + 1 Camera. Lifter-2 and Lifter-3 sat unassigned; the only Camera left, Camera-1, was executing Search & Service (done in ~45 s). Suggest answered "No workable plan with the drones left on this mission"; the operator abandoned about 3 s later. Chaining Camera-1 onto the Supply Drop after Search & Service would have saved it.
